method: Recover compiler-generated constant identities only. Each accepted slot has a precise VC6 value-encoded float/double symbol, identical full typed payload in read-only retail storage, and a unique contiguous instruction context in both bodies. All non-floating relocations in that context resolve to established symbols and addends; register and non-reference operands agree, with injective EBP local-slot mapping. Context branches are alignment anchors, not a proof of complete control-flow or source behavior. Two 1.0f candidates at 0x8a4c0 and 0x8a4c4 were rejected because their actual contexts do not correspond to the literal use.
